# crosswork_data_gateway_resource_configuration (Data Source)

This data source can read the collectors of the Crosswork Data Gateways with their memory and state, the settings of the Resource configuration page. A cluster lists only the collectors it has.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_data_gateway_resource_configuration" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `collectors` (Attributes List) The collectors that the cluster lists, with their memory and state (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collectors))
- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--collectors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collectors`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the collector is enabled, the Enable collector checkbox
- `memory` (Number) Memory of the collector in MB
- `name` (String) Name of the collector, as the Resource configuration page shows it
